draft.title: Democracy in the colonies
card: Own parliaments
In the 1850s, colonies such as New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania gained their own parliaments. These made laws for the colony, instead of the British government doing it all.
Votes for men
Most adult men in the colonies could vote. This was a wider right to vote than in Britain at the time. Women could not vote.
Secret ballot

In a secret ballot, voters mark their choice in private. Before this, people often called out their vote in public, so others could pressure them. Victoria and South Australia used the secret ballot in 1856, among the first places in the world to do so.
Why it mattered
Self-government, a wide male vote and a secret ballot meant ordinary men had more say in who made the laws.
draft.remember: The 1850s colonies gained parliaments, gave most men the vote and used the secret ballot.

a.q: What was the main purpose of the secret ballot?
opts: To let voters choose without pressure from others
To let women vote in colonial elections for the first time
To give the colonies control over their own laws
To make voting compulsory for all adult men
a.why: A secret ballot means no one can see how a person voted, so they cannot be pressured. Gaining parliaments is a different change, and women could not vote in the 1850s.
a.clue: Think about what changed from calling out a vote in public.

b.q: Tom is a farm worker in Victoria in 1857. His boss wants him to vote for a certain candidate. How did the secret ballot protect Tom's choice?
opts: He marked his vote in private, so his boss could not see it
The British government counted his vote on his behalf
He was excused from voting if his boss disagreed
His vote was announced aloud so everyone knew it was fair
b.why: With a secret ballot Tom's choice stayed private, so his boss could not check it or punish him. Calling votes out in public was the old method that allowed pressure.
b.clue: Who can see a vote that is marked in private?

a.best: To let voters choose without pressure from others

b.best: He marked his vote in private, so his boss could not see it
